basic_details.job_title: SEEPZ SEZ Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline for 6 Superintendent, Preventive Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Development Commissioner, SEEPZ Special Economic Zone, Mumbai (Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India) is filling 6 posts on deputation: 1 Superintendent (Adhikshak) and 5 Preventive Officers (Nivarak Adhikari). Only officers of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs may apply. Applications go through proper channel, by post, to the Development Commissioner, SEEPZ Special Economic Zone, at Andheri (East), Mumbai. content_sections.heading: About SEEPZ Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: SEEPZ Special Economic Zone is located at Andheri (East), Mumbai, and its administration is run by the Office of the Development Commissioner under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. The vacancy circular (Rikti Paripatra) is dated 25 November 2026 and is signed by Mayur R. Mankar, Joint Development Commissioner, SEEPZ-SEZ, Mumbai. The posts are filled on deputation, so the circular is meant for serving government officers, not for fresh candidates.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and willing officers who can be relieved if selected may apply in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) through proper channel, with the required documents, to this address: Development Commissioner, SEEPZ Special Economic Zone, Government of India, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, SEEPZ Service Centre Building, Andheri (East), Mumbai - 400096 The office can be contacted at [email protected] or on 022-28290856/28294700, and its website is www.seepz.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the vacancies. The number of posts and the place of posting may vary according to the actual requirement at the time of selection. Officers of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs who meet condition (a) and condition (b): (a) (i) holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR (ii) with three years' service in the grade, rendered after appointment on a regular basis, in the scale of Rs. 6500-200-10500 (pre-revised) (Pay Band Rs. 9300-34800 and Grade Pay Rs. 4600) or an equivalent scale in the parent cadre or department; AND (b) two years' experience in the procedural working of Excise or Customs. Candidates who have received Non-Functional Upgradation in Level-9 (9300-34800 + Grade Pay Rs. 5400/-) in their parent department can also apply for the Superintendent post. If selected, their pay on deputation will be fixed as per the DoPT clarification described below. Officers of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs who meet condition (a) and condition (b): (a) (i) holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR (ii) with six years' service in the grade, rendered after appointment on a regular basis, in the scale of Rs. 4500-7000 (pre-revised) (Pay Band Rs. 5200-20200 and Grade Pay Rs. 2800) or an equivalent scale in the parent cadre or department; AND (b) two years' experience in the procedural working of Excise or Customs. The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation should not be more than 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. The same limit applies to both posts. The notice does not print a minimum age or any age relaxation. As per the clarification issued through DoPT ID Note No. 1268489/2017-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 24.10.2017, a person who draws a higher pay scale or grade pay because of financial upgradation under MACP, Non-Functional Upgradation (NFU) or Non-Functional Selection Grade (NFSG) is eligible for deputation to an ex-cadre post carrying a lower pay scale or grade pay that is equal to the pay scale or grade of the substantive post in the parent cadre. Under the guidelines proposed by DoPT on deputation (duty) allowance, if basic pay in the parent cadre has been raised through NFU, MACP, NFSG and similar schemes, the upgraded basic pay will not be taken into account for calculating the deputation (duty) allowance. Selected officers will be entitled to transfer travelling allowance and joining time as per the Government of India rules in force. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of APAR for the last five years, duly attested by the competent authority (mandatory for the posts at serial numbers 01 and 02). Vigilance clearance certificate. Integrity certificate. Details of penalties imposed during the last 10 years, if any, and of pending or contemplated departmental proceedings. Incomplete applications, and applications received without the documents and conditions mentioned above, will not be considered.

DoPT rules, regulations and provisions on deputation issued from time to time will apply. As per DoPT Office Memorandum No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, a government officer working in a higher grade pay or pay scale is not eligible for appointment on deputation to a post with a lower grade pay or pay scale. Only officers who can be relieved if selected should apply. The Development Commissioner, SEEPZ-SEZ reserves the right to amend and/or withdraw the vacancy circular at any time without giving any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SEEPZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts on deputation: 1 Superintendent and 5 Preventive Officers. The number of posts may vary according to the actual requirement at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within 45 days of the publication of the advertisement in a newspaper, which is about 09 January 2027 (45 days from 25 November 2026). Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the SEEPZ Superintendent and Preventive Officer posts?
faq.answer: Only officers of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs who hold analogous posts on a regular basis or have the required regular service in the feeder grade, and who have two years' experience in the procedural working of Excise or Customs.

faq.question: Q4. What service is needed in the feeder grade?
faq.answer: For Superintendent, three years' regular service in the Rs. 6500-200-10500 (pre-revised) scale (Pay Band Rs. 9300-34800, Grade Pay Rs. 4600) or equivalent; for Preventive Officer, six years' regular service in the Rs. 4500-7000 (pre-revised) scale (Pay Band Rs. 5200-20200, Grade Pay Rs. 2800) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment on deputation should not be more than 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Superintendent carries Rs. 9300-34800/- with Grade Pay Rs. 4800/- (Level-8 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix), and Preventive Officer carries Rs. 9300-34800/- with Grade Pay Rs. 4600/- (Level-7).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for SEEPZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) through proper channel, with the required documents, to the Development Commissioner, SEEPZ Special Economic Zone, SEEPZ Service Centre Building, Andheri (East), Mumbai - 400096.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation period will ordinarily be 03 (three) years as per DoPT guidelines, and the total deputation, including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q9. Can officers with NFU in Level-9 apply for the Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have received Non-Functional Upgradation in Level-9 (9300-34800 + Grade Pay Rs. 5400/-) in their parent department can apply for the Superintendent post, and their pay on deputation will be fixed as per the DoPT clarification dated 24.10.2017.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Attested APAR copies of the last five years, a vigilance clearance certificate, an integrity certificate, and details of penalties imposed in the last 10 years, if any, and of pending or contemplated departmental proceedings.
